display_information.name: Crowsnest
display_information.description: A lookout for what you install. Posts serious package risks where your team already looks.
display_information.long_description: Crowsnest checks the packages in your software projects and gives each one a plain call: Clear, Watch or Hold. This app posts every Hold to a channel you choose, and answers slash commands to scan a project, investigate one package, see what is affected if a publisher is compromised, and check status. It connects out to Slack, so no public web address is needed.

slash_commands.description: Scan a project folder for risky packages
What is affected if one publisher is compromised
How many packages are checked and what is open
